name: Ratikanta Baral
summary:
• 8+ years of end-to-end support experience managing mission-critical applications, ensuring continuous availability and L2/L3 resolution in
Healthcare, Finance, Ecommerce, and Supply Chain domains alongside Salesforce SRE cloud infrastructure environment setups.
• Hands-on experience supporting CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab), containerized applications (Docker/Kubernetes), and platform
monitoring/observability tools like Datadog, Grafana, and Splunk to track application health, APIs, and microservices.
• Strong experience in UNIX/Linux, Nginx, Apache, GCP, Oracle, MySQL, SQL, PL/SQL, Shell Scripting, Java, Python and Jenkins for
application support, production troubleshooting, performance tuning, and operational activities.
• Hands-on experience with Datadog, Grafana, Nagios, Microservices, Kafka, Redis and HSM, including application monitoring, operational
dashboards configuration, log analysis, service monitoring, real-time data flow monitoring and production issue troubleshooting.
• Experienced in ITIL, ITSM, Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management, with strong knowledge of incident
lifecycle, strict SLA/OLA adherence, escalation procedures and production support processes.
• Experienced in handling P0/P1 Critical Incidents, incident triage, major incident coordination, real-time troubleshooting, cross-functional
collaboration and end-to-end incident resolution to minimize business impact.
• Strong expertise in application monitoring, application log analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), database troubleshooting, SQL query
optimization, batch processing, job scheduling and production environment maintenance.
• Experienced in application deployment, release management, patching, upgrade activities, post-deployment validation and production
health checks, coordinating with Development, Infrastructure, Database and other support teams.
• Proficient in Shell Scripting, Crontab, Control-M and Jenkins for automation, scheduled job management, batch processing and reducing
manual operational activities.
• Experienced with JIRA, BMC Remedy, Salesforce (Sales Cloud & Service Cloud), Confluence, CyberArk, SFTP and WinSCP for
incident/ticket management, technical documentation, secure access, file transfer and production operations.
• Strong experience in preparing SOPs, Runbooks, AODs, technical documentation and knowledge articles, while driving operational
efficiency, preventive actions and continuous improvement.
• Strong understanding of Microservices architecture and cloud service models including SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and QaaS, with the ability to
support distributed application environments and production services.
